supportPages.shippingBody: We ship wholesale K-Beauty orders worldwide from Korea. Shipping costs and transit times depend on destination, order volume, and carrier selection. Our team confirms final shipping details after reviewing your inquiry or order.
supportPages.returnsBody: Due to the wholesale nature of our business, returns are handled on a case-by-case basis for damaged or incorrect shipments. Please contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos and your order reference.
supportPages.faqMoqQuestion: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
supportPages.faqMoqAnswer: MOQ varies by product and brand. Each product page shows box quantity requirements. For mixed-brand wholesale orders, submit a wholesale inquiry and our team will advise.
supportPages.faqShippingAnswer: Yes. HMT Korea supplies authentic Korean cosmetics to buyers worldwide with competitive wholesale pricing and export support.
supportPages.faqAuthenticAnswer: All products are sourced directly from authorized Korean suppliers and brands.
supportPages.contactBody: For wholesale pricing, export support, or order questions, reach out to our team.
